mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_point_record (user_id, type, amount, balance, reason, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balance}, #{reason}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, amount, balance, reason, create_time FROM user_point_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_point_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, amount FROM user_point_record WHERE create_time < #{expireTime} AND amount > 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY user_id, create_time
